passwordForHigh.rule1: It should contain printable characters only.
passwordForHigh.rule2: Password length should not be shorter than 8 characters.
passwordForHigh.rule3: Must contain at least 5 unique characters (abcabcabc not allowed).
passwordForHigh.rule8: Contains at least a Space or Symbols (e.g. $, &).
passwordForHigh.rule9: Could not contain username or the username in reverse order (case-insensitive).
passwordForHigh.rule10: Could not contain digits in continuous or reverse continuous order longer than or equal to 3 characters (e.g. BMC(123)ste, BMC(654)sfc, BMC(4567)ste, BMC(9876)sfc  are not allowed).
passwordForHigh.rule11: Could not contain case-sensitive alphabets in continuous or reverse continuous order longer than or equal to 3 characters (e.g. (ABC)347!,57$(fed)68k, (GHIJ)347!, 57$(kjih)68k are not allowed).
passwordForHigh.rule12: Could not contain symbols longer than 3 characters (e.g. 34Mgs57(?!$#)68k are not allowed).
passwordForHigh.rule13: Could not contain digits longer than 3 characters (e.g. Fgke(1245)#@, (4390)FGL$ are not allowed).
passwordForHigh.rule14: The Alphabet can contain no longer than 3 characters (case-sensitive) (e.g. Fg1s3as(FDGB), GleOp34!(asbd) are not allowed).

passwordFormedium.rule1: It should contain printable characters only.
passwordFormedium.rule2: Password length should not be shorter than 8 characters.
passwordFormedium.rule3: Must contain at least 5 unique characters (abcabcabc not allowed)
passwordFormedium.rule4: Cannot be the same as the username or the username in reverse order.
passwordFormedium.rule9: Contains at least a space or symbols (e.g. $, &).
passwordFormedium.rule10: Could not contain username or the username in reverse order (case insensitive) (eg,username=Hello, Password=th12(oLleH)_78 is not allowed).

passwordForLow.rule1: It should contain printable characters only.
passwordForLow.rule2: Password length should not be shorter than 8 characters.
passwordForLow.rule3: Must contain at least 5 unique characters (abcabcabc not allowed)
passwordForLow.rule4: Meets any three out of following 4 criteria:
passwordForLow.rule8: Contains at least a Space or Symbols (e.g. $, &).
passwordForLow.rule9: Could not contain username or the username in reverse order (pam_cracklib will check both) (case insensitive) (eg. username=Hello, both Password=th12(heLLo)_78 and Password=th12(oLleH)_78 is not allowed).

passwordForDisabled.rule1: It should contain Printable Characters only.
passwordForDisabled.rule2: Password length should not be shorter than 8 characters.
passwordForDisabled.rule3: Cannot be the same as the username or the username in reverse order.
passwordForDisabled.rule4: Must contain at least 5 unique characters (abcabcabc not allowed).

step1.title: CAK Unlock
step1.description: Start the CAK unlock process (State 2 to State 1).
step1.uploadSignedToken: Download the generated token, sign it, and upload the signed token (DOTTokenInstall).

step2.title: Disable DOT
step2.description: Perform a power cycle before proceeding to the Disable DOT (Remove CAK from ERoT RAM (State 1 to State 0)).
step2.uploadLakPub: Upload the public key file to disable DOT.

step3.title: Enable DOT
step3.description: Generate a token to enable DOT (State 3 to State 0).
step3.uploadSignedToken: Download the generated token, sign it, and upload the signed token (DOTTokenInstall).

step4.title: Install CAK
step4.description: Install the new CAK by uploading the public key file (State 0 to State 1).
step4.uploadLakPub: Upload the public key file to install the CAK.

step5.title: Lock CAK
step5.description: Lock the CAK to complete the process (State 1 to State 2).
step5.uploadLakPub: Upload the public key file to install the CAK.

step6.title: CAK Test
step6.description: Verify the keys are installed properly.

step7.title: CAK Sign Test
step7.description: Perform a sign test to verify the new CAK.
step7.uploadSignedToken: Download the generated token, sign it, and upload the signed token (DOTTokenInstall).
